descriptors.definition: Artificial Intelligence simulates human capabilities in machines to automate tasks, process extensive transaction data, and execute predictive analytics. It transforms accounting functions by enhancing forecasting, enabling automated data entry, and supporting fraud detection mechanisms.
inclusion: Automated processing of invoices and receipts
exclusion: Tasks exclusively dependent on unassisted human judgment
nearby_distinctions: Differentiated from manual data processing by its algorithmic learning capacity and automated prediction features.

descriptors.concept_name: Indian Accounting Standards and Information Technology Integration
descriptors.definition: Indian Accounting Standards operate as a principle-based framework where technology facilitates transaction validation and financial report generation through rule-based configurations. Proper account-level configuration ensures automated compliance checks, whereas improper setup shifts validation reliance toward manual spreadsheet applications or trained artificial intelligence tools.
inclusion: Automated report generation with pre-defined validation rules
exclusion: Purely manual reporting without technological configuration or validation tools
nearby_distinctions: Distinguishes between automated account-level rule configuration and post-generation manual spreadsheet validations.
